description: Figure 7 displays the accuracy of Llama3.3 on the PopQA dataset, plotted against the frequency of subject entities (s_pop), with the x-axis labeled “s_pop frequency (x10^4)” and scaled linearly from 1 to 19 in increments of 2. The y-axis, labeled “Accuracy,” ranges from 0.0 to 1.0. The plot contains two lines: a blue dashed line with circular markers and a green solid line with square markers. The blue line begins at an accuracy of approximately 0.8, rises to a peak near 0.95 at s_pop frequency 3, then declines to about 0.65 at frequency 7, rises again to approximately 0.85 at frequency 11, and then fluctuates with minor dips and rises before stabilizing near 0.95 at the highest frequency. The green line starts at approximately 0.4, rises to a peak of about 0.7 at frequency 5, then declines to a low of approximately 0.45 at frequency 9, rises again to about 0.65 at frequency 13, and then increases to approximately 0.85 at frequency 17 before leveling off near 0.95 at the final point. Both lines show a general upward trend as s_pop frequency increases, with the blue line consistently above the green line across the plotted range.
